## Recorded decisions (a finding that touches or contradicts one must name it in `decision`)
D1: Target -> Flemington, Melbourne Cup day Tue 3 Nov 2026, every race on the card (user)
D2: Purpose -> data-driven value picks; best educated decisions, no guarantees (user)
D3: Bet types -> Win, Place, Each-way, Trifecta, Quad, Multi where possible (user)
D4: "Quad" meaning -> Quaddie (Early Quaddie + Main Quaddie); First Four also shown per race (repo decision)
D5: Inputs -> long-form history, horse, jockey, trainer, owner and other relevant data (user)
D6: Data sources -> FormFav Pro (7-day trial covers Cup day) for form/predictions/jockey/trainer/runner stats/track bias + PuntersEdge free key for bookmaker win/place prices incl Sportsbet, tote, cons...
D7: No Betfair (user has no account); no scraping of racing.com/TAB/Sportsbet (user + terms of use)
D8: Secrets -> env vars FORMFAV_API_KEY, PUNTERSEDGE_API_KEY, APP_PASSWORD only; never in repo or chat (repo decision)
D9: Owner data -> PuntersEdge acceptances carry owner; shown per runner, not weighted (no owner strike-rate feed) (repo decision)
D10: Hosting -> online free tier (Render), password protected, phone-first, works on mobile data (user)
D11: Live -> app refreshes data and re-ranks picks automatically; polling interval respects API credit limits (user + repo decision)
D12: Stakes -> rank picks; optional budget input gives quarter-Kelly stakes with per-bet cap; never places bets (repo decision; user did not choose)
D13: Missing data -> show "no data" and skip the pick; never fabricate prices or probabilities (repo decision)
D14: Stack -> Python 3.13, FastAPI, uvicorn, httpx, jinja2; dev: pytest, ruff (repo decision)
D15: Deadline -> usable by Mon 2 Nov evening AEDT; Cup day fields final Sat 31 Oct (user)
D16: Responsible gambling footer with Gambling Help Online 1800 858 858 on every page (repo decision)
D17: PuntersEdge is required (field, scratchings, prices); FormFav is optional enrichment and every FormFav failure degrades to a visible warning (repo decision)
D18: Market consensus computed locally from /markets (per-book normalise, median) to save credits; /consensus endpoint not used (repo decision)
D19: Test payloads are synthetic but follow the vendor OpenAPI specs in .agent/api/; vendor examples kept in tests/fixtures for shape checks (repo decision)

D21: Quaddie legs -> Main = last 4 races, Early = 4 before; UI tells user to check bookmaker legs (repo decision)
D22: Multis -> Sportsbet win prices only (multis must be with one bookie); legs >= 15% win chance (repo decision)
D23: Staking -> quarter Kelly capped 5%/bet; exotics 1% of budget each (recommended only); total scaled to budget (repo decision)
D24: App password required: without APP_PASSWORD pages answer 503 with setup text (repo decision)
D25: Prices -> /racing/next-to-go (free plan, 2 credits whole card); /racing/markets needs Plus and is not used (repo decision, real-data test)
D26: Credits -> manual mode default: Load card (~2+3/race) and Refresh prices (2) buttons; Auto optional via toggle or PRICE_MODE=auto; credits left shown on every page (user)
D27: Hosting -> Render, deployed by user from main (user)

D30: Jockey/trainer factors kept: held-out accuracy identical with or without them (repo decision, backtest)

+    1 | # Private durable copies in Google Cloud Storage, verified after upload.
+    2 | #   raw-archive  (run by hand): the raw racing.com / Betfair files from the `data` branch, checked against
+    3 | #                research/archive/MANIFEST.sha256, bundled, uploaded, downloaded back and fully restored.
+    4 | #   live-mirror  (daily, or by hand): new files from the `live` branch, uploaded and checksum-verified;
+    5 | #                nothing in the bucket is ever deleted or overwritten.
+    6 | # Needs repository secrets GCP_SA_KEY (a service-account JSON key) and GCS_BUCKET (bucket name).
+    7 | name: archive-to-gcs
+    8 | on:
+    9 |   workflow_dispatch:
+   10 |     inputs:
+   11 |       job:
+   12 |         description: "raw-archive or live-mirror"
+   13 |         required: true
+   14 |         default: raw-archive
+   15 |   schedule:
+   16 |     - cron: "17 14 * * *"     # daily live mirror, 01:17 Melbourne summer time
+   17 | permissions:
+   18 |   contents: read
+   19 | jobs:
+   20 |   raw-archive:
+   21 |     if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.job == 'raw-archive'
+   22 |     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+   23 |     timeout-minutes: 120
+   24 |     steps:
+   25 |       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+   26 |         with: {path: code}
+   27 |       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+   28 |         with: {ref: data, path: data, fetch-depth: 1}
+   29 |       - uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2
+   30 |         with: {credentials_json: "${{ secrets.GCP_SA_KEY }}"}
+   31 |       - uses: google-github-actions/setup-gcloud@v2
+   32 |       - name: Verify the data branch against the manifest
+   33 |         working-directory: data
+   34 |         run: sha256sum -c --quiet ../code/research/archive/MANIFEST.sha256 && echo "all $(wc -l < ../code/research/archive/MANIFEST.sha256) files match"
+   35 |       - name: Bundle
+   36 |         run: |
+   37 |           mkdir -p out
+   38 |           cd data
+   39 |           for y in 2022 2023 2024 2025 2026; do tar -cf ../out/meetings-$y.tar big/meetings/$y-*; done
+   40 |           tar -cf ../out/racingcom-history.tar racingcom/history
+   41 |           tar -cf ../out/racingcom-runs.tar racingcom/runs
+   42 |           tar -cf ../out/betfair-raw.tar betfair/raw
+   43 |           cd ../out
+   44 |           sha256sum *.tar > BUNDLES.sha256
+   45 |           cp ../code/research/archive/{MANIFEST.sha256,files.jsonl,VERSIONS.json,README.md,restore.sh,adaptive.log,big.log} .
+   46 |           cp ../code/research/dataset/{collect_adaptive.py,rcq.py} .
+   47 |       - name: Upload (never overwrite)
+   48 |         run: gcloud storage cp --no-clobber out/* "gs://${{ secrets.GCS_BUCKET }}/raw-archive/2026-10-29/"
+   49 |       - name: Download back and restore every file
+   50 |         run: |
+   51 |           mkdir check && gcloud storage cp "gs://${{ secrets.GCS_BUCKET }}/raw-archive/2026-10-29/*" check/
+   52 |           cd check && sh restore.sh restored
+   53 |

+   56 |     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+   57 |     timeout-minutes: 60
+   58 |     steps:

+   63 |       - uses: google-github-actions/setup-gcloud@v2
+   64 |       - name: Upload new observation files (no deletes, no overwrites)

+    1 | # Live racing.com observations for prospective evaluation (tools/live_collector.py).
+    2 | # Runs back to back: each run collects for about 5 h 40 min; a new run queues every 20 minutes and
+    3 | # starts when the previous one ends. Observations are committed append-only to the `live` branch.
+    4 | name: live-collector
+    5 | # The collector runs on Azure now (azure/function/, timer every minute). Kept as a manual fallback only:
+    6 | # run it by hand with manual = yes, and only while COLLECTOR_DISABLED=1 on the Function, or both collect.
+    7 | on:
+    8 |   workflow_dispatch:
+    9 |     inputs:
+   10 |       manual:
+   11 |         description: "yes = run on GitHub (only while the Azure collector is off)"
+   12 |         default: "no"
+   13 | concurrency:
+   14 |   group: live-collector
+   15 |   cancel-in-progress: false
+   16 | permissions:
+   17 |   contents: write
+   18 | jobs:
+   19 |   collect:
+   20 |     if: github.event.inputs.manual == 'yes'
+   21 |     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+   22 |     timeout-minutes: 350
+   23 |     steps:
+   24 |       - name: Collector code (main)
+   25 |         uses: actions/checkout@v4
+   26 |         with:
+   27 |           path: code
+   28 |       - name: Observation store (live branch)
+   29 |         uses: actions/checkout@v4
+   30 |         with:
+   31 |           ref: live
+   32 |           path: store
+   33 |           fetch-depth: 1
+   34 |       - name: Collect
+   35 |         working-directory: store
+   36 |         run: |
+   37 |           git config user.name "melbcup-live-collector"
+   38 |           git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
+   39 |           python3 ../code/tools/live_collector.py --out observations --git . --max-seconds 20400

### FILE CLAUDE.md
      ...
+    1 | # Working rules from the owner
+    2 | 
+    3 | - **Collect and collate data with repeatable workers that use no tokens**, wherever possible. That
+    4 |   means scripts, GitHub Actions and scheduled jobs (for example `tools/live_collector.py`), not
+    5 |   agents. Agents cost tokens.
+    6 | - **Never start Fable without the owner asking.** Fable is reserved for complex analysis, critical
+    7 |   thinking and outside-the-box thinking, and only on request. When Fable runs, scripts do the data
+    8 |   collection and token burn is kept to a minimum.
+    9 | - **Run substantial multi-step work under the `drainclamp-build-adhd` skill**, so its state is
+   10 |   durable and tracked by milestone.
+   11 | - Be mindful of credits.
+   12 | - Push to main with `git push origin build/cup-day:main`.
+   13 | - Keep API keys out of the repository.

-      | better than starting price. Edges above +40% and runners over $21 lost heavily, so the app
-      | never calls them value.
